title: oboobot config.toml
description: Structural shape of the daemon's TOML config file (daemon::config::Config), expressed as JSON Schema for documentation purposes. The file itself is TOML, not JSON.

version.description: Config schema version. Omitting this entirely is read the same as version = 1. A version newer than the running build's CURRENT_CONFIG_VERSION is rejected at load time.

base_risk_percent.description: Percent of equity risked per trade before any multiplier.

max_risk_percent.description: Hard ceiling apply_multiplier enforces after the Tuesday/Double-SMT multiplier is applied.

spread_multiplier.description: Spread filter rejects a cycle whose current spread exceeds this multiple of the recent rolling average.

correlation_exposure_threshold.description: Live |Pearson coefficient| at or above which two pairs count as the same correlation cluster for exposure limiting.

pairs.description: One entry per correlated pair-set this strategy watches. The real cycle iterates every entry.

primary.description: e.g. "EURUSD". Which asset in a divergence ends up trading is decided per cycle by strategy::smt, not fixed by this label.

notifications.description: Names of environment variables to read secrets from, never the secrets themselves.
